description: Header file defining specialized template structures for matrix multiply-accumulate (MMA) operations in CUDA, specifically for different data types and layouts within the CUTLASS library, including various specializations for fp16, int8, int4, and gather operations.

classes.name: DefaultMma
classes.description: Template struct providing specialized MMA implementations for different data types and layouts, including support for fp16, int8, int4, and gather-based operations, with multiple specializations for different architecture and stage configurations.

methods.name: DefaultMma<...>::Mma
methods.description: Type alias for the core MMA implementation based on DqMma with specific template parameters.

methods.name: DefaultMma<...>::IteratorA
methods.description: Type alias for the iterator over tiles from operand A.

methods.name: DefaultMma<...>::IteratorB
methods.description: Type alias for the iterator over tiles from operand B.

methods.name: DefaultMma<...>::ThreadblockMma
methods.description: Type alias for the threadblock-scoped pipelined matrix multiply operation.
